question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"experiences"** refers to the process of encountering or undergoing an event or occurrence. (अनुभव करता है)

 
 
• **Example: **He **experiences **a sense of joy whenever he listens to his favorite music.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate word to fill in blank number 2 is **'experiences'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exaggerates** (बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर बताना): To represent something as being larger, better, or worse than it really is.

 
 
• **Example:** She always **exaggerates** her stories to make them more interesting.
 
 
 
• **Enunciates** (स्पष्ट उच्चारण करना): To pronounce words or parts of words clearly.
 
 
• **Example: **He **enunciates** every word so clearly that everyone understands him.
 
 
 
• **Excavates** (खोदता है): To make a hole or channel by digging.
 
 
• **Example:** The archaeologist **excavates** the site to uncover ancient artifacts.
 
 

5c:Tbd7,

The correct answer is **Option 1)**
